status: Fixed research baseline promoted after additional validation
scope: Additional Q-strategy validation, not an exact replication of all paper tables
universe: At each month-end, only columns with 504 complete positive past observations; historical index membership remains unavailable
candidate: All directed log-OLS residual ADF tests with default AIC. Collapse each unordered pair to the more negative t direction, alphabetic ties; this is a declared common orientation rule, not recovered author code.
M: Maximum sum of negative ADF t over disjoint edges, maxcardinality=False
B: Top K edges by negative ADF t, where K equals that month's M count
U: Alphabetically deterministic unweighted maximum-cardinality matching, lexicographically truncate to K if necessary
signal: Original public Q20 using rolling504 endpoint residual series; no Z invented
primary: Q, stockgross=1, delay1, costs 0/5/10 basis points per traded dollar, each cost case with independent actual shares/cash/NAV
delay0: Idealized execution at the same close used to compute the instruction; earns only next day's return
delay1: Entire dollar-weight instruction including monthly selection delayed by one additional trading session; first day cash
budget: Reserve absolute frozen holdings first; normalize tradable target stock net gross or pair pre-net gross to remaining 1-NAV budget
missing: No signal imputation. Unquoted held quantities freeze, last-price mark, recovery jump recognized when a new price appears; only observed final holdings liquidated
statistics: Joint-date moving-block bootstrap of M-B and M-U differences; 21 sessions/4000 draws primary, 5 and 63/2000 draws sensitivity; zero risk-free rate; 252 days
subperiods: 2017-2019, 2020-2023 and calendar years; these are retrospective robustness splits, not a fresh holdout
jump_diagnostic: Exclude 2018-01-02 return row in statistics only; does not repair selection, signal or compounding paths
interpretation: Comparison of full selection policies under common rules. Neither M-B nor M-U isolates a pure overlap-removal causal effect. One deterministic U is not a random-control distribution.
primary_inference: M minus B Sharpe difference at stockgross, delay1, 5bp; 95% joint-date 21-session moving-block interval. Other costs/rules/subperiods are robustness diagnostics; no selection of a winning rule.
known_discontinuity_sensitivity: Before inspecting new returns, exclude both SRE and CPRT from the entire candidate graph and reselect all months. Primary stockgross/delay1 and all three fees only. Retrospective data-quality sensitivity, not a complete repair of corporate actions.
specification_role: Record of locked rules; model constants are implemented in src, not dynamically configured by editing this JSON.
